items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: She finally got another husband by the name of Goldberg and he interfered with the money -- something like that -- I left her then.

ctx.x: Let me ask a little bit about Mamie in terms of what was her personality like as a person?

Mamie, in my mind, was what we called a shouter. She wasn't a blues singer like Bessie. Bessie was truly a blues singer. But Mamie was the first to record and naturally she would be the first one considered. She was a very fine looking woman, nice personality, easily led. She usually had a husband that was a big bruiser, one of those kinds of things, taking all of her money. She finally got another husband by the name of Goldberg and he interfered with the money -- something like that -- I left her then. Anyhow,…
